Audit the standardization

Source: R/recipient-type.R
pf_status_audit.Rd

Frequency table of raw status strings by assigned type, most common first. Use it to find spellings the cascade still misses before trusting the scope split on a new extract.

Usage

pf_status_audit(x, detail = NULL, n = 50)

Arguments

x

Character vector of raw SIGOCPYRFSTA values.

detail

Optional recipient_type_detail to restrict to (e.g. "unrecognized").

n

Maximum rows to return.

Value

A data frame of status_norm, recipient_type, recipient_type_detail, and count.
